title.zh: 用永续合约做空 TQQQ 对冲现货：核查后的深度报告
title.en: Shorting TQQQ through a perpetual: the verified deep dive

zh: **按交易所实际给出的保证金和资金费率**（维持保证金 2.5%，如币安和 Bitget；资金费率年化约 +5%），1/3 对冲的年化收益大约等于国库券（2010 到 2026 年 2.6% 到 2.9%），比“少拿一点 QQQ”的同波动率组合每年少 0.6 到 1.1 个点，最近三年少 2 到 3 个点。原报告的基准（1/3 对冲、5 倍杠杆）在这个条件下亏钱：年化 −0.7%，比组合少 5.1 个点，每年爆仓 4.5 次。
**唯一不明显输给“少拿 QQQ”的配方**：空头名义价值为现货的 0.20，2 倍逐仓保证金，每月重置。在 2.5% 维持保证金、+5% 资金费率下，2010 到 2026 年比同波动率的 QQQ 加国库券组合多 0.3 个点，最近三年少 0.5 个点，基本打平；只有资金费率维持在 +10% 左右才能多出约 1.3 个点，而这只在 2026 年 10 月中旬以后出现过。

**全部超额收益来自资金费率。** 基金的“磨损”（固定仓位持有一个月，比 −3 倍 QQQ 每年多赚名义价值的 7.4%）大部分是基金自己的管理费和融资成本（4.7 到 5.3 个点），按 1/3 对冲收到的钱和同样资金买国库券差不多；其余 2.0 到 2.7 个点是赌指数震荡，201 个月中有 80 个月为负。5 倍杠杆的爆仓每年约少赚 1 个点，不是原报告说的“损失 5% 到 6% 的净值”。

**如果还想做**：空头名义价值为现货的 0.20（或 0.25），2 倍逐仓保证金，每月重置，选在你的仓位大小下维持保证金不高于 2.5% 的交易所（币安、Bitget 10 万 USDT 以内、MEXC 2%、OKX 2%、Gate 1%）。TQQQ 要在一个月内从上次重置价涨约 46% 到 48% 才会爆仓（16.7 年里两次），5 倍杠杆是 17% 到 19%（每年三到四次）。不要在 KuCoin 的分档下做 5 倍：10 万美元的账户最多 4 倍，年化 −9.9%。

**预期收益是国库券加上资金费率超过约 3% 的部分**，并接受 2010 年的 1 美元只变成 4.72 美元，而 QQQ 变成 18.89 美元。0.20 对冲、2 倍杠杆在 2010 到 2026 年的盈亏平衡点取决于拿什么比：按研究的 1% 维持保证金、对同样波动率的 QQQ 加国库券组合是 2.7%；按交易所的 2.5% 维持保证金，对卖出 QQQ 到同样日度贝塔是 2.9%，对同样波动率的纳斯达克 100 期货是 3.4%。最近三年这三个数分别是 6.1% 到 6.8%（截至 2026-08 和 2026-10 的窗口）、7.2% 和 7.9%（国库券平均 4.45%）；按同一种方法，期货把门槛抬高 0.4 到 1 个点（第 8a 节）。交易所、自动减仓、下架、税务和托管问题没有任何回测能定量，足以抹掉不到一个点的优势。
**监管内的替代路线（纳斯达克 100 期货）给出同样的对冲，而且没有固定的爆仓线；它是永续合约要打败的基准。** 做空 MNQ / NQ 几乎等于少拿 QQQ：扣 QQQ 0.18% 管理费后，被对冲部分每年赚国库券加约 0 到 0.3 个点（第 8a 节）。
en: **At the margin and funding the venues actually show** (2.5% maintenance, as at Binance and Bitget, and funding of about +5% a year), the one-third hedge earns about what T-bills pay (2.6-2.9% a year over 2010-2026) and trails simply holding less QQQ (the same-volatility QQQ/T-bill mix) by 0.6-1.1 points a year, and by 2-3 points over the last three years. The study's base case (one-third, 5x) loses money there: -0.7% a year, 5.1 points below the mix, liquidated 4.5 times a year.

**The one recipe that is not clearly worse than holding less QQQ**: hedge 0.20 of spot value in TQQQ notional, 2x isolated margin, reset monthly. At 2.5% maintenance and +5% funding it is +0.3 points above the same-volatility mix over 2010-2026 and -0.5 below it over the last three years, a wash; it beats the mix by about 1.3 points only if funding stays near +10%, which it has done only since mid-October 2026.

**Every point of edge is funding.** The fund's "decay" (7.4% a year of TQQQ notional over a plain -3x, held in fixed units for a month) is mostly the fund's own fee and financing (4.7-5.3 points), which on a one-third hedge collects about what T-bills pay on the same capital; the rest (2.0-2.7 points) is a bet that the index chops, negative in 80 of 201 months. Liquidations at 5x cost about 1 point a year, not the "5-6% of NAV" the first write-up said.

**If you still want it**: hedge 0.20 (or 0.25) of spot value in TQQQ notional, 2x isolated margin, monthly reset, on a venue whose maintenance is 2.5% or lower for your size (Binance, Bitget up to 100k USDT, MEXC 2%, OKX 2%, Gate 1%). TQQQ must rise about 46-48% from the last reset price within a month to liquidate it (twice in 16.7 years) against 17-19% at 5x (three to four times a year). Never 5x on KuCoin's tiers, where a $100k book is capped at 4x and lost 9.9% a year.

**Expect T-bills plus whatever funding pays above about 3%**, and accept that $1 in February 2010 became $4.72 against $18.89 in QQQ. The 0.20 / 2x break-even over 2010-2026 depends on the yardstick: 2.7% against the same-volatility QQQ/T-bill mix at the study's 1% maintenance; at the venues' 2.5% maintenance, 2.9% against selling QQQ to the same daily beta and 3.4% against Nasdaq-100 futures at the same volatility. Over the last three years the same three are 6.1-6.8% (windows to 2026-08 and 2026-10), 7.2% and 7.9% (T-bills averaging 4.45%); within one method, futures raise the hurdle by 0.4-1 point (section 8a). The exchange, auto-deleveraging, delisting, tax and custody questions are unsized by any backtest and can erase an edge of under a point.

**The regulated alternative, Nasdaq-100 futures, gives the same hedge with no fixed wipe-out level; it is the benchmark the perpetual has to beat.** Shorting MNQ / NQ is almost exactly holding less QQQ: after QQQ's 0.18% fee the hedged part earns T-bills plus roughly 0-0.3 points a year (section 8a).

zh.heading: 8a. 监管内的替代路线：纳斯达克 100 期货
three_lines: **做空 MNQ / NQ 对冲 QQQ，几乎等于“少拿一点 QQQ，其余放国库券”。** 扣除 QQQ 的 0.18% 管理费后，被对冲的部分每年赚国库券加大约 0 到 0.3 个点（2023 到 2025 年高利率时约 0.4 到 0.5），没有资金费率收入，没有固定的爆仓线，交易成本每年约为名义价值的 0.01%。
**它抬高了永续合约要过的门槛。** 配方 A 要在同样波动率下跑赢期货路线，资金费率在 2010 到 2026 年要高于约 3.4%，按最近三年的利率（国库券平均 4.45%）要高于约 7.9%；各交易所三个月的平均资金费率是 4.6% 到 7.5%，所以按最近三年的利率和最近的资金费率，期货路线略胜（按今天 4.04% 的国库券计算的门槛没有算）。
**它的代价是操作上的。** 要有能交易芝商所（CME）期货的美元保证金账户，合约粗（一张 MNQ 约 5.7 万美元），纳指上涨时每天要付现金，税务取决于居住地。2010 年以来最差的一个月，每 100 万美元现货、0.6 的对冲要付约 14.4 万美元；规模小时只能粗调。它不能对冲个股，也消除不了放在加密交易所的现货本身的托管风险。
paragraphs: 本节于 2026-11-06 加入，概括 [futures_route/FUTURES_ROUTE.md](futures_route/FUTURES_ROUTE.md)：四个工作组研究了这条路线，四位核查者逐项重算或重读来源，只用被确认的结论（已按更正修改），无法核查的标为未知。它不是第四种策略，而是永续合约要打败的监管内基准。做法：现货 QQQ 不动，在期货账户里卖出纳斯达克 100 指数期货（NQ 每点 20 美元，微型合约 MNQ 每点 2 美元；现金交割；每季度展期）。
对比：永续配方 A 在同样的 10 万美元上要存 10,000 美元。每一笔期货亏损都伴随现货的上涨（对冲 0.57 时现货涨得比期货亏得多，对冲 1.14 时略少），但现金要在期货账户里付出；追加保证金不到位，券商一般会不事先通知地平仓。保证金随时可以上调，芝商所自己的保证金水平没有读到。
**盈亏平衡的资金费率（永续要高于它才跑赢期货）：**
按同一种方法，期货比“卖出 QQQ”把门槛抬高 0.4 到 1 个点（取决于利差）。7.9% 是按最近三年的平均利率，不是按今天的利率。其中一部分来自一个假设：永续的保证金不生息，而期货的保证金赚国库券。
**同样波动率的回测（简表；k 是期货空头占现货的比例，k=0.60 和配方 A 的市场暴露相当）：**

+0.02 在模型误差之内（独立重算是 +0.08），而且完全取决于假设的 +0.25% 利差。配方 A 相对期货：资金费率 +5% 时 2010 到 2026 年多约 0.2 个点（0.17 到 0.23），最近三年少约 0.6 到 0.7 个点；+10% 时多约 1.2 和 0.4。配方 A 是在同一段样本上选出的。完整的表、压力期和期货的实际负担见 FUTURES_ROUTE.md 第 3 节。
**四条路线：**
**个股和托管。** 用 QQQ 或 NQ 对冲单只大型科技股，样本外只能降低 18% 到 42% 的日波动；8 只大型股的等权组合则去掉约 69% 的波动，最大回撤从 −46% 减半到 −22%。换成期货只把对冲腿的自动减仓、下架、爆仓线和托管风险拿走；如果现货放在加密交易所，它的托管还在原处，上涨时还要把现金及时送到券商那里。

**准入和税务（不构成税务建议）。** 新加坡居民：期货属于“指定投资产品”，开通前要做客户账户审核（来自券商常见问题页面，SGX 原页面没有读到）；股票和金融工具的买卖收益一般不征税（IRAS），除非被认定为以交易为业（交易标志只有二手资料）；QQQ 股息被美国预扣 30%，被对冲部分每年约少 0.13 个点。中国大陆居民：IBKR 自 2025 年起收紧开户；QQQ 股息预扣 10%，每年约少 0.045 个点；期货收益如何归类没有确认。美国人：NQ / MNQ 是第 1256 条合约（60% 按长期、40% 按短期），但持有 QQQ 同时做空指数期货“很可能”构成第 1092 条的混合跨式（工作组自己的判断，没有来源直接这样说），第 1259 条（推定出售）是否适用没有答案。详见 FUTURES_ROUTE.md 第 6 节；请咨询税务顾问。

en.heading: 8a. The regulated alternative: Nasdaq-100 futures
three_lines: **Shorting MNQ / NQ against QQQ is almost exactly "hold less QQQ and keep the rest in T-bills".** After QQQ's 0.18% fee the hedged part earns the T-bill rate plus roughly 0 to 0.3 points a year (about 0.4-0.5 in the high-rate years 2023-2025), with no funding income, no fixed wipe-out level, and trading costs of about 0.01% of notional a year.

**It raises the bar the perpetual has to clear.** For recipe A to beat the futures route at the same volatility, funding must exceed about 3.4% a year over 2010-2026 and about 7.9% at the last three years' rates (T-bills averaging 4.45%). The venues' three-month average funding was 4.6-7.5%, so at recent rates and recent funding the futures route edges ahead (the hurdle at today's 4.04% T-bill was not computed).

**Its costs are practical.** A USD margin account with access to CME futures, coarse contracts (about $57k per MNQ), cash paid out daily when the Nasdaq rises, and tax rules that depend on where you live. In the worst month since 2010 a 0.6 hedge paid out about $144k per $1M of spot, and small books can only size coarsely. It does not hedge single stocks, and it does not remove the custody risk of spot held on a crypto exchange.
paragraphs: Added on 2026-11-06, this section summarises [futures_route/FUTURES_ROUTE.md](futures_route/FUTURES_ROUTE.md): four workstreams studied the route and four verifiers re-ran each number or re-read each source; only confirmed claims are used (with the corrections applied), and what could not be checked is marked as unknown. It is not a fourth strategy but the regulated yardstick the perpetual has to beat. The route: keep the QQQ, and in a futures account sell Nasdaq-100 index futures (NQ pays $20 per index point, the micro MNQ $2; cash settled; rolled quarterly).
**Example: US$100,000 of QQQ** (at the Nasdaq-100 close of 28,437.17 on 2026-11-04, one MNQ is $56,874).

For comparison, perpetual recipe A posts $10,000 on the same $100k book. Every futures loss comes with a gain on the spot (larger than the loss at a 0.57 hedge, slightly smaller at 1.14), but the cash has to be paid into the futures account; if a margin call is not met, the broker generally closes the position without prior notice. Margins can be raised at any time; CME's own level was not read.
**Break-even funding (the perpetual beats futures only above it):**

Within one method, futures raise the hurdle over "sell QQQ" by 0.4-1 point, depending on the spread. The 7.9% is at the last three years' average rate, not today's. Part of it comes from an assumption: the perpetual's margin earns nothing while the futures margin earns T-bills.
**The backtest at matched volatility, compact** (k is the futures short as a share of spot; k = 0.60 has recipe A's market exposure):

The +0.02 is within model noise (an independent rebuild gives +0.08) and rests entirely on the assumed +0.25% spread. Recipe A against futures: at +5% funding about 0.2 points ahead over 2010-2026 (0.17-0.23) and 0.6-0.7 behind over the last three years; at +10%, about 1.2 and 0.4 ahead. Recipe A was chosen on the same sample. The full table, the stress period and the futures' practical burdens are in FUTURES_ROUTE.md section 3.
**The four routes:**

**Single stocks and custody.** Hedging one big tech stock with QQQ or NQ cut its daily volatility, out of sample, by only 18-42%; an equal-weight basket of eight megacaps lost about 69% of its volatility and saw its worst fall halve, from -46% to -22%. Moving the hedge to futures takes auto-deleveraging, delisting, the wipe-out level and custody off the hedge leg only; if the spot sits on a crypto exchange its custody stays where it is, and in a rally cash still has to reach the broker in time.

**Access and tax (not tax advice).** Singapore residents: futures are Specified Investment Products, so the broker runs a Customer Account Review first (per broker FAQs; the SGX page was not read); gains on shares and financial instruments are generally not taxable (IRAS) unless the activity is judged a trade (badges of trade: secondary sources only); QQQ dividends lose 30% to US withholding, about 0.13 points a year on the hedged amount. Mainland residents: IBKR has tightened account opening since 2025; QQQ dividends lose 10%, about 0.045 points a year; how futures gains are classified was not confirmed. US persons: NQ / MNQ are Section 1256 contracts (60% long-term, 40% short-term), but long QQQ against short index futures is "very likely" a Section 1092 mixed straddle (the workstream's own judgment; no source says so directly), and whether Section 1259 (constructive sale) applies is unresolved. See FUTURES_ROUTE.md section 6; ask a tax adviser.

did_not_survive.intro_zh: 每条一行。前两条是被推翻的专题结论，其余是被纠正的说法（原说法 → 核查结果）。
did_not_survive.intro_en: One line each. The first two are refuted specialist findings; the rest are corrected statements (claim → what checking found).
zh: “没有交易所提供研究假设的 1% 维持保证金” → Gate 的 TQQQX_USDT 第一档就是 1%（20 万 USDT 以内，50 倍）；MEXC 和 OKX 2%；专题研究者只看了 8 家中的 3 家。KuCoin / Bitget 的分档和全部模拟数字成立。
“5 倍杠杆爆仓是每月的常态，约一半是收盘能撑过去的插针” → 静态线在 28% 的月份被越过；48% 是收在线上的比例，不是线下；26 次收在线下的里 23 次重置前照样爆仓。
“这是上线以来最好的两周” → 币安最好的 15 天是 10 月 9 到 23 日的 0.685%，最近 15 天排第 14。
KuCoin 共同窗口 6.7%（和“上线以来 11.3%”）→ CSV 少了 105 次结算，补齐后 5.2%。

“所有交易所上限 ±2%，利率分量 0” → 上限：币安、KuCoin ±2%，OKX ±1%，Bitget ±1%，MEXC ±3%，Gate ±0.02%；利率 0 只在币安、OKX、Gate、KuCoin（及一位核查者的 Aster）核实。Bybit “10 倍” → 公告 20 倍；Aster 上线 06-27 → API 06-29；Hyperliquid “282 个 xyz 市场” → 142（结论“没有 TQQQ”成立）。
“2026 年股票永续跌后付空头更多、急涨时转负” → 靠 2026 年 4 月（上线月）和 8 月一周；去掉 4 月 QQQ 永续相关系数 −0.05；到 6 月 10 日的下跌 KuCoin −26.6%。“BTC 永续表现出 README 的模式” → 7 个崩盘窗口只有 2 个为负。
“资金费率逐年减半则低于国库券” → 只有 5 倍（0.96%）低于 1.51%，3 倍（1.97%）高于；“BTC 资金费率随市场成熟衰减” → 周期性，均值 11.6%。实际 2026 年窗口 +0.34% / +0.90% → 周末多算，正确是 +0.16% / +0.74%，且常数 10% 时也只有 +0.84%。
“形状最多移动 0.3 个点” → 约 0.5（ETH 形状 +0.46；崩盘为负路径未重新定中）。
“4.8 + 2.6 的拆分不可复现” → 从 leveraged.py 的成本模型可复现（4.82 + 2.53）；拆分依定义在 4.7 到 5.3 / 2.0 到 2.7 之间。
“复利项期望约为零或略负” → 样本 +2.03% / 年，t 值 1.7，和 0 分不开；“无爆仓的 1.88% 低于国库券” → 高于（国库券年化 1.51%）。
“磨损随持有期缩短” → 每周 +1.45 < 每月 +2.35，非单调；“只在指数波动小于一个标准差时跑赢 −3 倍” → 二阶近似，月度 98.5% 符合，季度 91%。
“VIX 20 到 30 是反弹区间，按季亏 6.6%” → 只在月初 VIX 下成立，按期内平均 VIX 它是最好的季度组；t 值 −0.87；2020-04 的 VIX 是 53.5，不在该组。
“平衡点由趋势决定，和波动无关” → 5 倍控制涨幅后与波动偏相关 +0.34；2022 年平衡点 −14.2%（网格插值 −13.1%）。
“损失保证金 0.4% 到 6.4%”作为额外扣除（磨损专题结论 4）；“每年损失 5% 到 6% 净值”（README）→ 重复计数，爆仓规则成本 5 倍 1.0 个点。
流量列“% of NAV” → 期初净值单位（基准资金费率 4.0% 实为当日净值的 3.0%；0.1 对冲“损失保证金 5.6%”实为 1.4%）；已改表。

README：“半个月 0.5% 年化约 14%” → 12.2%；“费率低于约 +5% 就不如组合” → 1/3 对冲 5 倍的平衡点约 9%，+5% 时还少 1.3；“0.2 对冲 2 到 3 倍每月重置是回撤 15% 以内里最好的” → 前两名是“从不重置”（12.3%、12.2%），每月 3 倍第三（12.0%）；“夏普 3” → 只在 +20%（3.28），+10% 时 1.23；“1999 年涨势每年爆仓 5 次” → 13 次，约每年 12 次；“不重置时对冲比例从 1/3 降到很低” → 平均 0.31，涨时上升、跌后塌缩；2013 / 2023 年表里的 QQQ 和 TQQQ 是年内首收到末收（标准日历年是 +36.6% / +139.7% 和 +54.9% / +198.0%）；`--spot BTC-USD` 原来跑不通（已修）。
“SPY 在每种设置下都输” → 费率 ≤10% 时成立，+15% 到 +20% 时 28 个变体最多 +0.9；“没有 QQQ 加 IEF 组合能达到对冲的回撤” → 只在 2010 到 2026 年（债券熊市）成立，2010 到 2019 年 QQQ 加 IEF 反超 1.4 到 1.5 个点；“同回撤下优势翻倍” → 对 200 日线只是 ×1.3，且全靠 2022 年。

“24 小时低估 3.0 → 3.3 次” → 两次是 NQ 换月假象，3.2 次，相对组合约 0 而不是 −0.1；“2 倍 0.12 → 0.18 次 / 年” → 2 次变 3 次；“盘外高于纽交所最高价 2% 以上的 25 天” → 21 到 22 天是跳空低开日；Bitget 对 TQQQ 夹 5% → 表上没有 TQQQUSDT（通用 3%）；引用的 KuCoin 指数文章不含股票永续规则（正确的是 48142946141603）。
“研究设为零的成本” → 研究设了 0.05% 手续费；0.5% 强平费是公开费率（0.06%）的约八倍的压力假设，0.5% 滑点未测量。
“9 条 README 说法有错” → 硬错误 6 到 7 条；建模约定“互相抵消” → 只在 5 倍。
en: "No venue offers the study's 1% maintenance" → Gate's TQQQX_USDT tier 1 is 1% (up to 200k USDT, 50x); MEXC and OKX 2%; the specialist read 3 of 8 venues. The KuCoin / Bitget tiers and every simulated number hold.

"Liquidations at 5x are a monthly regularity, about half are wicks survivable at the close" → the static line is crossed in 28% of months; 48% is the share closing above the line, not below; 23 of the 26 close-below events would have been liquidated anyway before the reset.
"The last fortnight is the best since listing" → Binance's best 15 days paid 0.685% (9-23 October); the last 15 rank 14th.
KuCoin 6.7% over the common window (and "11.3% since listing") → the CSV lacked 105 settlements; gap-filled 5.2%.

"All venues cap at ±2% with interest 0" → caps: Binance and KuCoin ±2%, OKX ±1%, Bitget ±1%, MEXC ±3%, Gate ±0.02%; interest 0 verified only on Binance, OKX, Gate, KuCoin (and Aster per one verifier). Bybit "10x" → 20x per its announcement; Aster listed 06-27 → API onboard 06-29; Hyperliquid "282 xyz markets" → 142 (no TQQQ holds).

"2026 stock perps paid shorts more after falls and turned negative in rallies" → rests on April 2026 (a launch month) and one August week; without April the QQQ-perp correlation is -0.05; the fall to 10 June had KuCoin at -26.6%. "BTC perps show the README's pattern" → only 2 of 7 crash windows negative.

"If funding halves every year the hedge earns below T-bills" → only at 5x (0.96% vs 1.51%); 3x (1.97%) is above. "BTC funding fell as the market matured" → cyclical, mean 11.6%. The realised 2026 window +0.34% / +0.90% → weekends over-credited; +0.16% / +0.74%, and +0.84% even at a constant 10%.
"Shape moves the CAGR by at most 0.3 points" → about 0.5 (ETH-shaped +0.46; the crash-negative path was not re-centred).
"The 4.8 + 2.6 split is not reproducible" → it reproduces from leveraged.py's cost model (4.82 + 2.53); the split is definition-dependent within 4.7-5.3 / 2.0-2.7.

"The compounding term has roughly zero or slightly negative expectation" → the sample says +2.03% a year, t = 1.7, not distinguishable from zero. "1.88% with no liquidations is below T-bills" → it is above (T-bill CAGR 1.51%).

"The decay shrinks with the holding period" → weekly +1.45 < monthly +2.35, non-monotone. "Beats -3x only when the index moves less than one sigma" → a second-order rule; 98.5% of months, 91% of quarters.
"VIX 20-30 is the rebound band, losing 6.6% a year quarterly" → ex-ante only; by mean VIX it is the best quarterly band; t = -0.87; 2020-04 (VIX 53.5) does not belong to the band.
"The break-even is set by the trend, not volatility" → at 5x the partial correlation with volatility is +0.34; 2022's break-even is -14.2% (grid interpolation gave -13.1%).
"Margin lost 0.4-6.4%" as a deduction (decay_regimes-4) and "losing 5-6% of NAV a year" (README) → a double count; the liquidation rule costs 1.0 point at 5x.
Flow columns labelled "% of NAV" → units of starting NAV (base funding 4.0% was 3.0% of the day's NAV; hedge 0.1 "margin lost 5.6%" was 1.4%); the tables are now in shares of the day's NAV.

README: "0.5% in half a month, about 14% a year" → 12.2%; "below the mix at anything under about +5%" → the one-third hedge at 5x breaks even near 9% and is 1.3 below at +5%; "hedge 0.2 at 2-3x monthly is the best under a 15% worst fall" → the top two are reset-never (12.3%, 12.2%), monthly 3x is third (12.0%); "Sharpe 3" → only at +20% (3.28), 1.23 at +10%; "the 1999 rally liquidated it five times a year" → 13 times, about 12 a year; "the hedge ratio fell to a fraction without resets" → mean 0.31, rising in rallies and collapsing after falls; the year table's 2013 / 2023 QQQ and TQQQ figures are first-close-to-last-close (calendar-year returns are +36.6% / +139.7% and +54.9% / +198.0%); `--spot BTC-USD` did not run (fixed).

"SPY loses at every setting" → true at funding of 10% or less; at +15% to +20% 28 variants win by up to +0.9. "No QQQ+IEF mix reaches the hedge's drawdown" → 2010-2026 only (bond bear); in 2010-2019 QQQ+IEF beats the hedge by 1.4-1.5. "At the same worst fall the edge roughly doubles" → x1.3 against the 200-day rule, and all on 2022.

"T-bill 4.54% in the latest window" → 4.41% (4.54% is the window ending 2026-05); "the break-even rose from 0-0.4% to 6.1%" → not monotone: 3.8% already in the window ending 2020-02, maximum 6.5% in the window ending 2026-05.

"24/7 raises liquidations from 3.0 to 3.3" → two of the extra five are NQ roll artefacts: 3.2, vs mix about 0 rather than -0.1; "2x 0.12 → 0.18 a year" → 2 events to 3; "off-hours high above the NYSE high by more than 2% on 25 days" → 21-22 of them are gap-down days; "Bitget clamps TQQQ's mark to 5%" → TQQQUSDT is not on the page (generic 3%); the cited KuCoin index article has no stock-perp rule (48142946141603 does).
"Costs the study set to zero" → the study set fees at 0.05%; the 0.5% close-out fee is a stress about eight times the documented 0.06%, and the 0.5% slippage is an assumption.
"9 of 31 README claims are wrong" → 6-7 hard errors; "the modelling conventions cancel" → at 5x only.
did_not_survive.disagreements_zh: **两位核查者意见不一致之处**（报告不选边）：Gate 的 1% 是否算“有交易所提供”（一位认为无实质问题，另一位据此推翻）；Aster 的上限和利率分量是否可读（±2%、0 对 未公开）；Bybit 是否“查到”（20 倍、06-24 的公告 对 未触及）；KuCoin 6.7%（一位接受，一位发现缺口）；4.8 + 2.6 是否可从脚本推出（一位按二阶定义复现 4.69 + 2.66，一位认为任何脚本都推不出，第三位从 leveraged.py 推出 4.82 + 2.53）；“1999 年五次”是无依据还是反向错误；“趋势决定平衡点”在 5 倍是否成立；债券组合结论是否稳健；24 小时代理 3.3 次是否含换月假象；“一半是插针”是否成立。
did_not_survive.disagreements_en: **Where the two verifiers disagreed** (the report takes no side): whether Gate's 1% tier counts as a venue offering the study's maintenance (one found "none material", the other refuted the finding on it); whether Aster exposes a cap and interest rate (±2% and 0 vs not exposed); whether Bybit was "reached" (20x, 2026-06-24 per its announcement vs never reached); KuCoin's 6.7% (accepted vs the 105-settlement gap); whether 4.8 + 2.6 can be derived from any script (reproduced under the quadratic definition as 4.69 + 2.66 vs not derivable, with a third verifier deriving 4.82 + 2.53 from leveraged.py); whether "1999 five times a year" is unsupported or wrong in the other direction; whether "the trend sets the break-even" holds at 5x; whether the bond-mix result is robust; whether the 24/7 proxy's 3.3 includes roll artefacts; whether "half are wicks" holds.

zh: **资金费率是参数，不是观察。** +10% 高于所有交易所三个月的均值（4.6% 到 7.5%），只有最近 30 天达到；0.5% 的半个月是 12.2% 年化，且只出现过约三周。方向（崩盘时转负还是转正）没有定论（第 2 节）。

**监管内的替代品，现在已经比较过（第 8a 节）。** 做空纳斯达克 100 期货（MNQ / NQ）给同样的贝塔对冲，没有固定的爆仓线，几乎等于少拿 QQQ：扣 QQQ 0.18% 管理费后，被对冲部分每年赚国库券加约 0 到 0.3 个点（2023 到 2025 年约 0.4 到 0.5）。和它比，配方 A 在 +5% 资金费率下 2010 到 2026 年每年多约 0.2 个点（同样日度贝塔），最近三年少约 0.6 到 0.7 个点；要在同样波动率下跑赢期货，资金费率在 2010 到 2026 年要高于约 3.4%，按最近三年国库券平均 4.45% 要高于约 7.9%。这取代了原来的算式（“在 5% 费率、4.4% 利率下约为 0”）和“美国 60/40 税收待遇”的说法：60/40 只适用于美国持有人，而对他们来说跨式和推定出售的问题都还没有答案。
**自动减仓和下架。** 崩盘时空头是最赚钱的仓位，保险基金不足时最先被自动减仓强平（KuCoin 和币安的合约都标注 `isDeleverage: true`），也就是对冲恰好在起作用时可能被拿走；下架则按交易所的指数强制现金交割，时间由不得你。没有人建模或估算。Aster 93% 的结算为 0 说明小交易所盘口很薄。

**税务和会计。** 美国持有人：境外加密永续不是 §1256 合约，多 QQQ 空 TQQQ 永续很可能构成 §1092 跨式（亏损递延，持有期重置），收到的资金费率很可能按普通收入征税（未核实）；中国居民：加密衍生品交易本身是问题。新加坡居民：股票和金融工具的买卖收益一般不征税（IRAS），除非被认定为以交易为业（交易标志只有二手资料）；QQQ 股息被美国预扣 30%（没有税收协定）；境外加密衍生品平台在金管局的监管之外（金管局 2020 年国会答复），永续路线没有新加坡的保护。中国大陆居民：境外投资收益按全年已实现盈亏的净额征税（财新；20% 的税率没有从原始来源确认）；银发〔2026〕42 号（2026-02-06）重申虚拟货币相关业务属于非法金融活动，USDT 保证金的股票永续是否在其范围内没有确认。回测不变，但足以抹掉 0 到 1 个点的优势。以上不构成税务建议（第 8a 节）。
**基差。** Bitget 永续在美东 16:00 平均比纽交所收盘价高 0.32%（标准差 0.15%，最大 +0.76%，150 天），KuCoin 高 0.25%，从未相差 1% 以上；周五收盘到周一开盘的永续变动（标准差 2.5%，−5% 到 +6.5%）和 TQQQ 自己的跳空一样大。
**仓位大小和流动性**（第 1 节）：分档随名义价值上升，持仓量和实际滑点没有人测。
**分红。** TQQQ 除息（收益率约 1%）和各交易所指数是否调整没有查；方向已知（指数不调整时空头赚除息跌幅），金额小。
**样本内选择。** 0.2 / 2 倍配方是在同一段 2010 到 2026 年样本上选出并“确认”的；55 个滚动窗口约 5 段独立；同波动率组合事后配置。
**原报告已有的**：合约在美股休市时交易（第 3 节已量化，样本无崩盘）；不重置时对冲比例漂移（涨时上升、跌后塌缩：“从不重置”平均 0.31，2022 到 2023 年只有 0.17 到 0.19，它多出的 2.7 个点约 1.1 来自更低的平均对冲，其余来自跌后反弹期间对冲不足、一半的手续费和一半的爆仓）；交易所对手方风险；对冲掉的部分等于不持有现货。
en: **Funding is a parameter, not an observation.** +10% is above every venue's three-month mean (4.6-7.5%) and was reached only in the last 30 days; 0.5% per half month is 12.2% a year and has occurred for about three weeks. Its direction in a crash is not established either way (section 2).

**The regulated alternative, now compared (section 8a).** Shorting Nasdaq-100 futures (MNQ / NQ) gives the same beta hedge with no fixed wipe-out level and is almost exactly holding less QQQ: after QQQ's 0.18% fee the hedged part earns T-bills plus roughly 0-0.3 points a year (about 0.4-0.5 in 2023-2025). Against it, recipe A at +5% funding leads by about 0.2 points a year (same daily beta) over 2010-2026 and trails by about 0.6-0.7 over the last three years; to beat futures at the same volatility it needs funding above about 3.4% over 2010-2026, or about 7.9% at the last three years' T-bill average of 4.45%. This replaces the earlier formula ("roughly zero at 5% funding and 4.4% rates") and the earlier "US 60/40 tax treatment": 60/40 applies only to US holders, and for them the straddle and constructive-sale questions are open.

**Auto-deleveraging and delisting.** In a crash the short is the most profitable position and the first to be force-closed by ADL when the insurance fund runs short (KuCoin's and Binance's contracts carry `isDeleverage: true`): the hedge can be removed exactly when it works. A delisting forces cash settlement at the venue's index, with no say on timing. Nobody modelled or sized either; Aster's 93% zero settlements show how thin the smaller books are.

**Tax and accounting.** For a US holder, offshore crypto perpetuals are not §1256 contracts, long QQQ against a short TQQQ perp is likely a §1092 straddle (losses deferred, holding period reset), and funding received is likely ordinary income (unverified); for a PRC-resident holder, crypto-derivative trading itself is the question. For a Singapore resident, gains on shares and financial instruments are generally not taxable (IRAS) unless the activity is judged a trade (badges of trade: secondary sources only), QQQ dividends lose 30% to US withholding (no treaty), and offshore crypto-derivative platforms are outside MAS oversight (MAS parliamentary reply, 2020), so the perpetual route has no Singapore protection. For a mainland resident, overseas investment gains are taxed on the year's net realised gains (Caixin; the 20% rate is not confirmed from a primary source), and notice 银发〔2026〕42号 (2026-02-06) restates that virtual-currency business is illegal financial activity; whether it covers a USDT-margined stock perpetual was not confirmed. None of it changes the backtest, but it can erase a 0-1 point edge. Not tax advice (section 8a).

**Basis.** At 16:00 ET the Bitget perp closed on average 0.32% above the NYSE close (sd 0.15%, max +0.76%, 150 days) and KuCoin 0.25%, never more than 1% apart; the Friday-close-to-Monday-open perp move (sd 2.5%, -5% to +6.5%) is the same as TQQQ's own gap.
**Size and liquidity** (section 1): tiers rise with notional; open interest and real slippage were not measured.

**Dividends.** TQQQ's ex-dividend drops (yield about 1%) and whether each venue's index adjusts for them were not examined; the sign is known (the short gains the drop on an unadjusted index), the size is small.

**In-sample selection.** The 0.2 / 2x recipe was chosen on the same 2010-2026 sample it is "confirmed" on; the 55 rolling windows hold about five independent periods; the same-volatility mix is set with hindsight.

**Already in the first write-up**: the contract trades when the stock market is closed (sized in section 3, no crash in the sample); without resets the hedge ratio drifts (it rises in rallies and collapses after falls: "reset never" held 0.31 on average but 0.17-0.19 through 2022-2023, and of its extra 2.7 points about 1.1 is the lower average hedge, the rest being under-hedged through the 2023 rebound, half the fees and half the liquidations); exchange counterparty risk; the hedged part is spot you do not own.

zh: 哪一个维持保证金对你适用：取决于交易所、名义价值分档，以及 Gate 的代币指数和 ±0.02% 费率上限是否可接受；Bybit 的分档没读到。
崩盘时股票永续的资金费率：没有样本。标记价格在休市崩盘时怎么走：只有 Bitget 的规则文本（指数最多偏离 10%，夹取“通常 3%”，TQQQ 未列出）。
自动减仓和下架的概率与代价；10 万到 100 万美元空头的实际滑点和持仓量；尖峰中续杯的滑点（假设 0.5%，持有的小时 K 线没有用来测）。
税务（美国跨式规则、资金费率的收入性质；中国居民的合规问题）和 USDT / 交易所托管风险（净值的 10% 到 20%）。
分红与各交易所的指数调整。
资金费率的长期水平：四个月到一年的新合约；BTC 的先例是周期性的，不能外推。
样本外：配方在同一段样本上选出；一段 2010 到 2026 年的历史，主要是牛市；1999 到 2010 年只有重建基金和收盘价爆仓。
纳斯达克 100 期货的利差：扣 QQQ 管理费后被对冲部分比国库券多赚 0 到 0.3 个点，是几个估计的范围，单个年份可以为负；按今天 4.04% 的国库券计算的盈亏平衡资金费率没有算（第 8a 节）。
芝商所自己的保证金页面（返回 503）和 IBKR 自己的佣金页面（返回 403）都没有读到；券商在追加期货保证金时能否自动以 QQQ 为抵押借钱。
期货路线的税务：中国大陆对期货收益如何归类、20% 税率的原始来源；美国持有人用指数期货对冲 QQQ 是否触发推定出售规则（第 1259 条）。
en: Which maintenance level applies to you: it depends on the venue, the notional tier, and whether Gate's token index and ±0.02% funding cap are acceptable; Bybit's tiers were not read.

Stock-perpetual funding in a crash: no sample. How the mark price behaves in a closed-hours crash: only Bitget's rule text (index at most 10% from the last close, clamp "typically 3%", TQQQ not listed).

The probability and cost of auto-deleveraging and delisting; real slippage and open interest for a $100k-1M short; refill slippage in a spike (0.5% assumed; the hourly candles the specialists held were not used to measure it).
Tax (US straddle rules, the character of funding income; compliance for PRC residents) and USDT / exchange custody risk on 10-20% of NAV.
Dividends and each venue's index adjustment.
The long-run funding level: four months to a year of new contracts; BTC's precedent is cyclical and does not extrapolate.
Out of sample: the recipes were chosen on the sample they are tested on; one 2010-2026 history, mostly a bull market; 1999-2010 only with a rebuilt fund and liquidations on the close.

The Nasdaq-100 futures carry: 0 to 0.3 points above T-bills after QQQ's fee is the range of several estimates, and single years can be negative; the break-even funding at today's 4.04% T-bill was not computed (section 8a).
CME's own margin page (it returned 503) and IBKR's own fee page (403) could not be read; whether a broker will lend against QQQ automatically to meet a futures margin call.

Tax on the futures route: how mainland China classifies futures gains and the primary source for the 20% rate; for US holders, whether an index futures hedge of QQQ triggers the constructive-sale rule (Section 1259).

disclaimer.zh: 仅为描述，不构成投资建议。

assumptions.en: Spot QQQ held; short in a cash-settled TQQQ perpetual on isolated margin, refilled after a liquidation; liquidation on the day's NYSE high at the maintenance level; taker fee 0.05% on perpetual notional and 0.05% on spot (0.06% in the realistic case); 5% cash reserve earning T-bills; margin earns nothing; funding on calendar days; constant funding. Real TQQQ 2010-02-11 to the data end; the 1999-2010 stress uses a rebuilt fund and liquidations on the close.
assumptions.zh: 持有 QQQ 现货；用逐仓保证金做空现金交割的 TQQQ 永续合约，爆仓后续杯；按当日纽交所最高价和维持保证金判断爆仓；永续名义价值吃单费 0.05%，现货 0.05%（现实情形 0.06%）；5% 现金储备买国库券；保证金不生息；资金费率按日历日、常数。真实 TQQQ 从 2010-02-11 到数据截止；1999 到 2010 年压力测试用重建基金，只按收盘价判断爆仓。

generation_notes: grid.json: the explorer grid uses the study's defaults (taker 0.05%, spot fee 0.05%, reserve 5%, refill, T-bills on cash); liq_cost is computed for every cell.

grid.json realistic_case and curves.json's 2.5%-maintenance series use taker 0.06% as DEEP_DIVE.md section 6 does (deep_dive/_verify/critic/realistic_case.py); at the study's 0.05% the same cells read about 0.05 points higher.

curves.json: weekly sampling (last trading day of each week) of daily growth and drawdown; the 1999-2010 stress uses perp_hedge.load_data(synthetic_before_2010=True), window 1999-03-11 to 2010-02-10, liquidations on the close only.

yearly.json and episodes.json are regenerated with the same code and data as yearly.csv / episodes.csv and match them to machine precision; DEEP_DIVE.md quotes the same figures (2020 +4.2% with 8 liquidations, 2023 +3.5% with 6).
funding.json: see its notes (KuCoin union with the verifiers' refetch; Binance from 2026-07-01; headline figures from DEEP_DIVE.md).

venues.json, the answer in six lines (`five_lines`, whose sixth item is the futures route), section 8a (`futures_route`), what did not survive checking, the drawbacks and what is still unknown are parsed verbatim from DEEP_DIVE.md (markdown emphasis markers kept).
decay.json: the specialist's CSVs (deep_dive/decay_regimes/); the split range and break-evens as DEEP_DIVE.md section 4 states them.

futures.json: the Nasdaq-100 futures route (DEEP_DIVE.md section 8a): the matched-volatility backtest (futures_route/backtest/headline.csv), the break-even funding (backtest/breakeven_funding.csv at 10% margin; the same-daily-beta rows and the chart from practical_case/four_routes.csv, carry 0.10% interpolated linearly between its 0 and 0.25% rows), the US$100,000 example (editor/derive_out.txt), the venues' 4.6-7.5% band (funding.json, Aster left out as DEEP_DIVE.md does) and the text blocks (FUTURES_ROUTE.md, verbatim); its headline numbers are checked against derive_out.txt and DEEP_DIVE.md section 8a.
